description:
Smart. Focused. Email.

Fast, cross-platform email designed to filter out the noise - so you can focus on what's important.
What's new:
- Draft text style: choose the font, size and color of AI drafts in Settings → Spark AI → Writing and Replies, for all accounts or per account.
- Auto-Drafts: turning Auto-Drafts off now offers to delete the ones already written.
- Teams: share a conversation with the entire team in one step.
- Fixes:
  - The Spark Assistant can create drafts from shared inboxes again.
  - The Assistant no longer counts declined events as busy when it looks for a free time.
We’re always here for you at support@sparkmailapp.com
P.S. If you encounter any issues with the automatic update, please use the following link to download the update manually:
https://downloads.sparkmailapp.com/Spark3/win/dist/3.33.1.141803/Spark.exe
